body:
Morning wiki tick is done. Overnight was quiet — just 3 assistant messages archived, nothing from you, everything landed in the raw archive and the private backup. No new durable claims, no new media.

The engine ran a cross-check between the commissioned-self page and the regenerated wiki-brain: verified every dependent claim, found exactly one number that moved (the instrument table page count went 476 to 595 as of yesterday, old value preserved), everything else confirmed fine. A re-check note was added and the stale warning cleared.

Queue: that job's done, no new jobs spawned, 8 blocked jobs unchanged (all waiting on you to boot story-time or wiki-subject sessions). All quality gates green, pushed clean.

Token check, 8:05–9:05am: 15.1M total (15.0M in / 152k out). Heaviest: wiki-brain-writeback-6h (4.0M), then main agent (3.5M). Biggest single inference: wiki-brain-writeback-6h at 2.8M. Up ~1% vs last hour.

Week-1 taste-model score is in, and it flopped honestly. The model predicted 8 keeps and got zero of them right — accuracy 63%, precision 0, recall 0.

The 3 tracks you actually kept (Bad Habit, Energy, Untouchable) were all missed entirely, and the model never even had audio data on them — they sat in the blind fallback group. Five more you liked but never added to the playlist.

For the 90% target: the miss pattern says audio features aren't carrying the keep signal at all. The model needs a different signal or it can't get there.

One caveat: the keep labels assume your current playlist is FUNDAMENTAL FLAW, which you never confirmed. If it's actually a different one, tell me and I'll recompute.

Burn-in digest for Sep 19–20: 48 windows scored, 30 live, 18 quiet. v1 flagged 10, v2 flagged 10, one alert. Engines agreed on 44 of 48.

All the flagged windows traced to one thing — your avatar-tag bursts late evening (€AB/€VID tags plus long image-path blocks), which inflate repetition metrics mechanically. The busy afternoon stretch (15:56–19:01 ET, 49–93 messages) ran clean on both engines.

What this does NOT prove: a flag is a style shift, not a diagnosis. Repetition from image refs isn't a change in you — it's a change in what you typed at the time.

Token check, 9:05–10:05am: 14.0M total (13.8M in / 268k out). Heaviest: taste-model-week1-scoring (3.9M), then main agent (3.9M). Biggest single inference: taste-model-week1-scoring at 3.9M. Down ~7% vs last hour.

Token check, 10:05–11:05am: 7.4M total (7.2M in / 127k out). Heaviest: main agent (2.2M), then stylo-v3-burnin-30m (1.7M). Biggest single inference: stylo-v3-burnin-30m at 958k. Down ~47% vs last hour.

Token check, 11:05–12:05pm: 6.5M total (6.5M in / 65.6k out). Heaviest: stylo-v3-burnin-30m (2.5M), then main agent (1.4M). Biggest single inference: stylo-v3-burnin-30m at 2.5M. Down ~11% vs last hour.

Token check, 12:05–1:05pm: 6.4M total (6.3M in / 39.9k out). Heaviest: stylo-v3-burnin-30m (2.0M), then main agent (1.7M). Biggest single inference: stylo-v3-burnin-30m at 984k. Down ~3% vs last hour.
Token check, 1:05–2:05pm: 5.9M total (5.9M in / 35.6k out). Heaviest: heartbeat (2.1M), then stylo-burnin-30m (1.2M). Biggest single inference: heartbeat at 1.5M. Down ~7% vs last hour.
